about: Document a problem, investigation, and verified result
title: "[Troubleshooting] "
labels: ""

---

## Symptom and scope

What failed? Which devices or paths are affected? Remove private details.

## Environment

Service, relevant versions, and recent changes.

## Evidence

Sanitized errors and observations.

## Hypothesis and action

What did you expect, what changed, and how can it be rolled back?

## Verification

Repeat the original test. Record the result and remaining uncertainty.
